decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal fails to comply with the minimum internal space standards contained in Supplementary Planning Guidance and would therefore result in a poor standard of living accommodation. The proposal would be contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.3.4 of the Unitary Development Plan Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit..

Condition : 2 - The proposal fails to demonstrate that an appropriate off-street parking arrangement can be provided and would be prejudicial to the free flow of traffic and general safety of road users. The proposal would be contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and T.1.4 of the Unitary Development Plan Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit.
description: Change of use of ground floor retail to self contained flat.
